findings.description: Removing the `seen` set makes the `__cause__` walk loop forever if the exception chain contains a cycle and no cause matches `exception_cause_types`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception whose __cause__ chain loops back on itself, e.g. a.__cause__ = b and b.__cause__ = a, is raised and retried with a retry predicate on exception causes. Mechanism: the while loop now only stops on None or a match, so it never terminates on the cycle. Impact: the retry decision hangs the calling thread instead of returning False.
